description: This file defines a class ConvertOctal within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions to convert octal numbers to binary, decimal, and hexadecimal formats, including handling Excel-specific behaviors and error conditions.

classes.name: ConvertOctal
classes.description: A utility class converting octal numbers to other formats, extending ConvertBase, with methods to convert to binary, decimal, and hex, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts an octal value to its decimal representation, handling two's complement for negatives.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts an octal value to its hexadecimal representation, with optional padding.
